regions.description: Regions to edit, marked as boxes on the image_urls references. Boxes on the first image mark where edits happen; boxes on the other images mark source objects to draw from. Refer to a region as @label (or @1, @2, … by position) in the prompt or in another region note.

label.description: Name used to refer to the region as @label in the prompt and region notes. It replaces the region's number: without a label, refer to the region by its 1-based position (@1, @2, …).

x.description: Left edge of the box, normalized to [0, 1].

y.description: Top edge of the box, normalized to [0, 1].

note.description: What to do with this region. Takes precedence over the prompt for its box.

image_idx.description: 0-based index of the image_urls entry this box is marked on.
